name: combat-reviews-preview
objective: Drive free app installs from fans planning their combat-sports weekend
targetAudience: Combat sports fans aged 18-34 who follow multiple promotions and argue about scorecards after every card

productFacts.label: Coverage
productFacts.detail: Combat Reviews covers every major combat-sports promotion in one app — MMA, boxing and kickboxing.

productFacts.label: Event details
productFacts.detail: Every card shows full fight order, start times in the viewer's own timezone, and broadcaster.

productFacts.label: Predictions
productFacts.detail: Users submit predictions before each card and see aggregated community picks per bout.

productFacts.label: Discussion
productFacts.detail: Round-by-round scorecards and post-fight discussion threads let fans settle disputed decisions with data.

productFacts.label: Price
productFacts.detail: The app is free to download and free to use; no subscription is required for event data or discussion.

eventFacts.label: Events this weekend
eventFacts.detail: 12 combat-sports events are scheduled across all covered promotions this weekend.

keyMessages: 12 events this weekend, all in one app
Predictions before the card, scorecards after it
mandatories: End on the Download Free call to action
